name: Stage Redundant Identity Cue Vocabulary 01

CNEG.name: Identical Ring Negative Control
CNEG.finding: Identical geometry cannot preserve redundant Character differentiation when visible names recede.

CINC.name: Incumbent Primitive Outline Control
CINC.finding: The primitive outline set remains legible but reads as a generic badge/shape vocabulary and is not a promotable candidate.

F1.name: Faceted Contour
F1.finding: The compact closed contours remain mechanically distinct, but their strongest reading is generic faceted gem/badge geometry. At small size several differences reduce to minor perimeter inflections, so the family does not establish a neutral authored identity vocabulary strongly enough to justify promotion.

F2.name: Broken Perimeter
F2.finding: Gap position survives monochrome and layout transfer, but the open-ring language reads primarily as progress/loading/gauge or activity state. That is exactly the predeclared forbidden drift for a cue required to remain immutable across Rest, Listening, Selected, Opportunity and Speaking.

F3.name: Offset Pair
F3.finding: The two-part relations remain visible at small sizes, but several members read as equals, pause-like, quotation-like or directional punctuation/control marks. The family therefore imports familiar sign semantics instead of remaining neutral identity support.

F4.name: Aperture Field
F4.finding: The aperture differences survive scale and forced colors, but the shared square field reads as an app/button/badge carrier and several apertures resemble familiar category-icon counters. The cue becomes software iconography rather than subordinate Character identity support.

cross_condition_findings: All four candidate families passed deterministic rendering, monochrome transfer, 320px transfer, forced-colors compatibility and immutable-geometry state-collision checks.
Mechanical survival does not rescue semantic drift: identity geometry must remain subordinate to names and must not imply mutable Stage state or familiar software meaning.
No candidate earned promotion solely because it remained differentiable when names were visually reduced.
No candidate failure depends on color preference, final typography, pips, arcs, rail semantics, ODR resolution or full-Stage composition.

incumbent_effect.law_preserved: Human-readable/programmatic Character identity remains primary; any later redundant visual cue must stay non-color, non-state, accessible and subordinate.

next_gate.action: After guarded promotion and serial closeout, run one bounded Phase-C re-entry audit to select the next single incumbent-refinement variable.
prohibitions: No CIR-S1 reroll, F5 replacement family, geometry retune or full-Stage cue render under this closed method.
Do not harden Observed Cues or resolve pips/arcs/right-rail semantics through this result.
Do not infer final iconography, palette, typography, motion, implementation or ODR authority.

cross_project_note: Ensemble-Project remains in active provider-sensitive E0-A work; central queue reconciliation remains debt and is not mutated by this Design result.
recursive_audit: Frozen method and exact harness hash remained unchanged after subjective exposure.
All four browser modes passed the mechanical verifier before subjective judgment.
Every candidate judgment maps to a predeclared falsifier rather than a new post-hoc taste rule.
Controls remain ineligible and no failed family is promoted by relative preference.
Zero survivors is explicitly permitted by the frozen result law.
No incumbent Stage geometry, background, state semantics or unresolved ODR question is changed.
audit_result: CIR-S1 CLOSED ZERO SURVIVORS. APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
